worldcombat.skill.bubble.summary: Blows out a fan of countless bubbles along the aim: foes across a wide arc ahead each take a light hit and may be left sudsy and slower; a faster user gets an extra volley. Dense suds are more numerous, stickier and softer; rapid bubbles fly farther and faster.
worldcombat.skill.bubble.use.0: A very short, PP-cheap poke to spam in a scuffle
worldcombat.skill.bubble.use.1: Hit several foes inside the arc ahead at once
worldcombat.skill.bubble.use.2: Make a fast foe slip and drag its Speed down
worldcombat.skill.bubble.description.0: Each caught target takes %1$s special damage once per cast; one breath fires %3$s volley(s) of %2$s bubbles each.
worldcombat.skill.bubble.description.1: The bubbles spread over a %1$s degree arc, reach %2$s blocks, fly at %3$s blocks/tick and have a %4$s block hit radius.
worldcombat.skill.bubble.description.2: On a hit, a %1$s chance to lower the target's Speed by %2$s stage(s) as a stat stage that does not recover when the foam ends, and the target is left sudsy for %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.bubble.dense.on: Dense suds: +2 bubbles per volley, arc x1.3, suds chance +10%, up to 2 stages and suds duration x1.4; costs power x0.85, bubble speed x0.85, range -1.5 blocks and wind-up +2 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.bubble.dense.off: Rapid bubbles: power x1.12, bubble speed x1.12, range +2 blocks and -1 bubble per volley; costs suds chance -4% and suds duration x0.8.
worldcombat.skill.bubble.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.bubble.preference.dens: On: +2 bubbles per volley, arc x1.3, suds chance +10%, up to 2 Speed stages and suds duration x1.4, for sliming and slowing a crowd; costs power x0.85, bubble speed x0.85, range -1.5 blocks and wind-up +2 ticks. Off (rapid bubbles): power x1.12, bubble speed x1.12 and range +2 blocks, at the cost of suds chance -4% and suds duration x0.8.
worldcombat.skill.bubble.preference.ai.m: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
worldcombat.skill.bubble.preference.ai.c: On: a target moving quickly ranks higher so the bubbles slow it first; off: all targets score the same.
worldcombat.skill.bubble.preference.ai.s: On: a target already carrying the shared sudsy identity ranks lower so the breath goes to a fresh foe; off: every target is treated alike.
